eli: just opened PR for a tiny Next starter that wires LangChain + a micro eval harness (github.com/redwood/sample-next-quickplay). CI kept failing on the edge target — 401s followed by a streaming timeout. anyone seen this pattern?

mira: can you paste the CI lines?

eli: ```
Error: 401 Unauthorized - missing api key
 at fetch (/workspace/node_modules/redwood-sdk/dist/fetch.js:23:10)
Retries exhausted
```

tony: that 401 usually means the demo is using NEXT_PUBLIC_* for server calls. Edge/SSR runtimes won't have secrets with NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix and it leaks to the client.

eli: doh, i used NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_KEY in the api route to make the template frictionless for new devs.

mira: swap to REDWOOD_API_KEY in server code and send Authorization header explicitly in edge handlers: `headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}` }`. Also add a short note in README explaining server vs client envs and Vercel edge caveats.

tony: another subtle bit: our JS SDK auto-retries some generation calls, but the minimal TypeScript sample and other language examples (Python/Go) in the repo don't include retries. For parity we should either opt-out of auto-retry in JS or add a tiny retry helper in non-JS samples. Filed a tiny docs task.

ops-bot: suggestion: include this snippet in the sample README for parity and debugging:
```js
// tiny retry helper for demos
const client = new RedwoodClient({ retry: { retries: 2, backoffMs: 120 } })
```

eli: the other CI failure was a streaming hang: the harness timed out after 30s with `Stream closed unexpectedly`. the demo used `await client.generate()` in an edge route which buffered.

mira: for streaming in edge you must use the streaming iterator and flush quickly. e.g.
```js
for await (const chunk of client.streamGenerate({ model: 'redwood-small', prompt })) {
  res.write(chunk)
}
res.end()
```
Also use a short keepalive/heartbeat so proxies don't drop the connection.

tonY: small spelling nit: make sure samples call `streamGenerate` only for models that support streaming — otherwise it will close immediately. Add a guard in the sample.

devex-bot: checklist suggestion: 1) fix env usage, 2) add retry helper and SDK parity note, 3) add streaming example + guard, 4) add CI smoke that runs sample in both node and edge runtimes.

eli: I'll update the PR with the env fix, add a small retry helper, and convert the edge route to streamGenerate with a model-supported guard. also adding a failing test that reproduces missing-key so we don't regress.

mira: nice. one UX request — can we add a one-line chooser in Console quickstart: "Pick 'quickplay' for minimal eval-only demos; pick 'starter' for streaming/agent features" — that stops folks from choosing the wrong template.

eli: will add that in the PR description. thanks for the help! :rocket:
